item.title: U.S. Pressures South Korea: "Delayed Investment in U.S. Will Lead to Higher Tariffs" (美 “대미투자 늦어지면 관세 인상” 압박)
item.description:
U.S. Pressures South Korea: "Delayed Investment in U.S. Will Lead to Higher Tariffs" (美 “대미투자 늦어지면 관세 인상” 압박)

The U.S. government has reportedly pressured the South Korean government, saying, "If you don't expedite investment in the U.S., we will raise tariffs." In response, the presidential office held an emergency meeting on the 13th with relevant ministries to discuss countermeasures. The U.S. imposed a 12.5% tariff on South Korea last month under Section 301 of the Trade Act (Super 301). However, additional procedures remain, which could push the rate above 15%. (미국 정부가 최근 우리 정부에 “대미 투자를 서두르지 않으면 관세를 올리겠다”고 압박한 것으로 알려졌다. 이에 청와대가 지난 13일 관계부처가 참여하는 긴급회의를 열어 대응책을 논의했다. 미국은 지난달 무역법 301조(슈퍼 301조)에 따라 한국에 12.5% 관세를 부과했다. 다만 추가적인 과정이 남아 있어 15%가 넘을 수도 있다.)

According to relevant ministries on the 14th, the U.S. Department of Commerce recently expressed strong dissatisfaction to the South Korean government that the $200 billion investment in the U.S. (excluding $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation) promised in the "Korea-U.S. Joint Fact Sheet (JFS)"—an outcome of the Gyeongju Korea-U.S. summit held last October—has not been carried out for 10 months. In response, the presidential office convened a meeting on the previous day with officials from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and other related agencies. At the time of the JFS signing, South Korea received a 15% reciprocal tariff on the premise of investment in the U.S. However, the U.S. federal court nullified that measure, and the U.S. administration newly set tariffs under Super 301. (14일 관계부처에 따르면 미 상무부는 지난해 10월 경주 한·미 정상회담 결과물인 ‘한·미 조인트팩트시트(JFS)’에서 약속한 2000억달러 규모 대미 투자(조선업 협력 1500억달러 제외)를 10개월째 집행하지 않고 있다는 불만을 최근 우리 정부에 강도높게 피력했다고 한다. 이에 청와대는 전날 산업통상부 등 관련 부처 관계자를 소집해 회의를 가졌다. JFS 체결 당시 한국은 대미투자를 전제로 상호관세 15%를 적용 받았다. 다만 미 연방법원이 이를 무효화했고, 미 행정부는 슈퍼 301조에 의거해 새롭게 관세를 책정했다.)

◇ U.S. Commerce Department Pours Out Complaints to South Korean Government: "Why No Results in 10 Months on U.S. Investment?" (◇美상무부 “대미투자 왜 10개월째 성과 없나” 한국 정부에 불만 쏟아내)

The presidential office said in a notice that day, "Discussions on the Korea-U.S. strategic investment projects are being held closely through various channels, and the government is responding by communicating frequently and closely on trade issues with the U.S." Some have floated the idea of Trade Minister Kim Jung-kwan visiting the U.S., but the presidential office said, "There are currently no confirmed plans for the trade minister's visit to the U.S." The JFS states that South Korea will "pursue" investments totaling $350 billion by the end of President Donald Trump's term (January 2029), including $150 billion in shipbuilding cooperation and $200 billion in strategic investment. (청와대는 이날 공지를 통해 “한미간 전략 투자 프로젝트와 관련해 다양한 채널을 통해 긴밀히 논의가 진행 중이며, 대미 통상현안과 관련해 정부 내에서도 수시로 긴밀히 소통하면서 대응 중”이라고 했다. 김정관 산업통상부 장관의 방미도 일각에서 거론되지만 청와대는 “산업부 장관의 방미 계획은 현재로서 정해진 바 없다”고 했다. JFS에는 한국이 도널드 트럼프 대통령 임기 종료(2029년 1월)까지 조선업 협력 1500억달러와 전략투자 2000억달러 총 3500억달러 투자를 ‘추진’한다고 명시돼 있다.)

The U.S. complaint stems from the fact that Japan announced its first (February) and second (March) investment projects in succession early this year, while South Korea has yet to announce its first U.S. investment project. However, since South Korea reached its tariff negotiation conclusion three months later than Japan and is currently finalizing a $20 billion gas combined-cycle power plant project in Texas as its first project, the U.S. dissatisfaction is being viewed as a "whip" to spur action. A government official said, "It appears to be influenced by the U.S. midterm elections in November," adding, "The selection of the first project is proceeding without disruption." (미국의 불만은 일본이 올해 초 1호(2월)·2호(3월) 투자 프로젝트를 연달아 발표한 데 비해, 한국은 아직 대미 투자 1호 프로젝트를 발표하지 않는다는 점이다. 다만 우리가 일본보다 관세협상 타결 시점이 3개월 늦었고, 최근 200억달러 규모의 미국 텍사스주 가스복합화력발전단지 건설을 1호 프로젝트로 구체화하고 있기 때문에 이 같은 미국의 불만을 ‘채찍질’로 받아들이는 분위기다. 정부 관계자는 “11월 미국이 중간선거를 앞둔 영향으로 보인다”며 “1호 프로젝트 선정은 차질 없이 진행중”이라고 했다.)

On the 23rd of last month (local time), the U.S. announced that it would impose tariffs of 10% to 12.5% on 60 countries that have not introduced or enforced measures to ban imports of goods produced through "forced labor" under Super 301. South Korea was subject to a 12.5% tariff. This came after the global tariffs originally imposed by the Trump administration were ruled illegal by the U.S. Supreme Court, leading to the new tariff assessment. The 12.5% applied to South Korea is not the final rate. Last month, Wi Sung-lac, the presidential office's national security director, said in a press briefing, "Additional tariffs could be added." (미국은 지난달 23일(현지시각) 슈퍼 301조에 따라 ‘강제 노동’으로 생산된 상품의 수입 금지 조치를 도입·시행하지 않은 60개국에 10~12.5%의 관세를 부과한다고 밝혔다. 한국에는 12.5%의 관세를 적용했다. 당초 트럼프 행정부가 부과했던 글로벌 관세가 미국 연방대법원에서 위법으로 판결나면서 새로 관세를 메긴 것이다. 우리에게 적용된 12.5%가 최종적인 세율은아니다. 지난달 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 기자브리핑에서 “추가적인 관세가 붙을 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: On mention of 'two-term or re-election constitutional amendment'... People Power Party: "Is Lee saying he'll step down and then come back?" (‘중임 또는 연임 개헌’ 언급에… 국힘 “李, 물러났다가 다시 하겠다는 건가”)
item.description:
On mention of 'two-term or re-election constitutional amendment'... People Power Party: "Is Lee saying he'll step down and then come back?" (‘중임 또는 연임 개헌’ 언급에… 국힘 “李, 물러났다가 다시 하겠다는 건가”)

The People Power Party on the 14th pushed back against President Lee Jae-myung personally mentioning a "four-year two-term presidency system," calling it "a trick for long-term power" and "a distraction following a plunge in approval ratings." (국민의힘은 14일 이재명 대통령이 직접 나서서 ‘4년 중임 대통령제’를 언급한 데 대해 “장기 집권을 위한 꼼수” “지지율 급락에 따른 시선 돌리기”라며 반발했다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook that day, "As I've said repeatedly, the prerequisite for a constitutional amendment is simple," adding, "It's declaring, 'I'll only serve one term as president.'" He then said, "Put aside your vain ambitions and tend to the livelihood ministries." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, "The essence is one thing. This is an attempt at a 'prison-break constitutional amendment,' where the president tries to break through his legal risks with a constitutional change. If there's even a fingernail's worth of sincerity about constitutional reform, he should come before the people and first promise 'no re-election' and 'I'll stand trial immediately.'" Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo called it "a trick to hold onto power for the long term." <<> The opposition suspects the president, facing record-low approval ratings, has turned to a constitutional amendment to shift the political landscape. Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min said, "Today, when the Gallup poll showed negative ratings surpassing positive ratings for the first time, the president and the presidential office talked about constitutional reform. The public thinks: 'A president who should stand trial after his term is trying to extend his term or eliminate his trial by any means — bringing up constitutional amendments and attempting to withdraw indictments.'" Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also called it "PR spin to divert attention amid a ratings crash." <<> Within the opposition, questions also arose about the fact that while President Lee's campaign pledge was a "four-year re-election system," the presidential office mentioned a "four-year two-term system" that day. People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Sang-beom, citing the constitutional provision that a constitutional amendment does not apply to the president in office at the time of the amendment, said, "A re-election constitutional amendment would have no effect on the president, but if a two-term system is combined with a shortened term, it could open the door for him to step down and then run again under the new constitution. It looks like nothing more than a scheme to step away from the presidency once and then come back." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “거듭 말하지만 개헌의 전제 조건은 간단하다”며 “‘대통령 한 번만 하겠다’고 선언하는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “허망한 욕심 그만 내려놓고 민생부처 챙기시기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: "Constitutional Amendment Discussion Should Be the National Assembly's" - Lee Passes the Ball, but Ruling and Opposition Parties Remain at Loggerheads (“개헌 논의는 국회가” 李는 공 넘겼지만 여야는 계속 대치중)
item.description:
"Constitutional Amendment Discussion Should Be the National Assembly's" - Lee Passes the Ball, but Ruling and Opposition Parties Remain at Loggerheads (“개헌 논의는 국회가” 李는 공 넘겼지만 여야는 계속 대치중)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th via X (formerly Twitter), "If we are to actually amend the Constitution, it is desirable that the specific details be decided in the National Assembly through agreement between the ruling and opposition parties," emphasizing that the constitutional amendment discussion should be entirely left to the National Assembly. The presidential office's position is that "rather than the government drafting its own amendment proposal, it is appropriate for the National Assembly to handle it." However, after Jo Jeong-sik, a key figure in the pro-Lee faction and National Assembly Speaker, said at his inaugural press conference last month that "a two-term presidency for a sitting president is a matter of the people's choice," seemingly leaving the door open for such a possibility, the People Power Party has stated it "cannot engage in constitutional amendment discussions," casting a shadow over future negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties. <<> A presidential office official also told reporters that day, "Since a constitutional amendment requires the consent of 200 or more lawmakers in the National Assembly, it is desirable for it to be discussed and pursued in the National Assembly." This implies that it would be difficult with the current number of seats held by the Democratic Party and that cooperation from the People Power Party is necessary. Constitutional amendment is the "top national agenda item" of the Lee Jae-myung administration. It was also one of President Lee's campaign pledges, and early in his term, the State Affairs Planning Committee released a draft amendment that included provisions for a four-year two-term presidency and a runoff voting system. <<> Subsequently, at a cabinet meeting in May, President Lee stated, "Undertaking a full-scale constitutional amendment all at once carries a heavy burden. It is necessary to take a pragmatic approach," expressing his position to push for sequential amendments, starting with issues that can be agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties, such as strengthening the requirements for declaring martial law and incorporating the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement into the preamble of the Constitution. At the time, former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik attempted to push forward this "one-point" amendment proposal but failed to secure bipartisan agreement. <<> Speaker Jo Jeong-sik plans to establish a Constitutional Amendment Advisory Committee directly under the National Assembly Speaker immediately after the regular session opens in September, and to form a special committee on constitutional amendment within the Assembly, aiming to finalize an amendment proposal after full-fledged discussions next year. The goal is to hold a national referendum on the amendment during the April 2028 general elections for the 23rd National Assembly. Speaker Jo also holds the position that proposals to amend the structure of government power, such as introducing a four-year two-term presidential system, should be included in the amendment. An official from the Speaker's office said, "No specific timeline or procedure has been decided yet," adding, "It will be settled based on future consultations between the ruling and opposition parties." <<> However, the People Power Party maintains that while a constitutional amendment is necessary, "discussions can only begin if the president explicitly rules out the possibility of a second term." Earlier, Speaker Jo sparked controversy on the 28th of last month at his first press briefing after taking office with remarks that seemed to hint at the possibility of amending the Constitution to allow a sitting president's re-election. Although presidential office aides later sought to clarify, saying, "President Lee has stated that a second term for a sitting president is impossible," the People Power Party has not let go of its suspicion that the constitutional amendment discussion is effectively an attempt to extend power. (이재명 대통령은 14일 X를 통해 “실제 개헌한다면 그 구체적 내용은 여야 합의로 국회에서 정하는 것이 바람직하다”며 개헌 논의는 전적으로 국회에 맡겨야 한다고 했다. 청와대는 “정부의 개헌안을 만들기 보다는 국회에서 하는 게 맞다”는 입장이다. 하지만 친명계 핵심인 조정식 국회의장이 지난달 취임 기자회견에서 “현직 대통령 연임은 국민 선택의 문제”라며 연임 가능성을 열어놓는 듯한 발언을 한 뒤 국민의힘이 “개헌 논의에 임할 수 없다”고 하면서 향후 여야 간 개헌 논의는 난항을 겪을 전망이다.)

item.title: Even the 4050 demographic is wavering: President Lee's approval rating hits record low of 44% (4050도 흔들린다, 李대통령 지지율 44%로 최저치)
item.description:
Even the 4050 demographic is wavering: President Lee's approval rating hits record low of 44% (4050도 흔들린다, 李대통령 지지율 44%로 최저치)

President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating, which had maintained 50-60% levels since taking office, has dropped to a record low of 44% in a Gallup Korea poll, with a notable exodus of support among the 4050 age group, the core support base of the current administration. (이재명 대통령 지지율이 한국갤럽 조사에서 취임 후 50~60%대를 유지하다가 최저치인 44%를 찍은 가운데, 현 정권의 핵심 지지 기반인 4050세대의 지지 이탈 현상이 두드러지고 있다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea from the 11th to the 13th targeting 1,000 adults nationwide aged 18 and over, positive evaluations of President Lee's job performance stood at 44%. This is down 7 percentage points (p) from the previous survey (51%) released on the 24th of last month. Responses saying he is "doing poorly" rose 8%p from the previous survey to 46%. (한국갤럽이 지난 11~13일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 조사한 결과 이 대통령 직무 수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 44%였다. 지난 달 24일 공개된 직전 조사(51%) 대비 7%포인트(p)가 낮았다. ‘잘못하고 있다’는 응답은 직전 조사보다 8%p 오른 46%였다.)

By region, he received support in the 30-40% range across all areas except Gwangju and Jeolla (71%). By age, all groups showed approval ratings in the 30-40% range except for those in their 40s (58%) and 50s (56%). However, approval among the 4050 demographic, the core support base of the Democratic Party, also fell by around 10% compared to the previous survey. (지역별로는 광주·전라(71%)를 제외한 전 지역에서 30~40%대의 지지를 받았다. 연령별로는 40대(58%)와 50대(56%)를 제외한 전 연령층이 30~40%대 지지율을 보였다. 다만 민주당의 핵심 지지층인 4050 지지율도 직전 조사보다 10%안팎이 빠졌다.)

President Lee's approval rating, which had exceeded 60% as recently as May just before the June local elections, has dropped about 20%p in just three months. Respondents in the Gallup poll cited real estate policies (30%), economic and livelihood issues (13%), overall poor performance (7%), reduction of prosecution powers and authoritarianism/arbitrariness (5%), and ethical concerns, including avoiding his own trial (4%), as reasons for negative evaluations. (6월 지방선거 직전인 지난 5월까지만 해도 60%대를 웃돌던 이 대통령 지지율은 3개월 만에 약 20%p 하락했다. 갤럽 조사 응답자들은 부정평가 이유로 부동산 정책(30%), 경제·민생(13%), 전반적 잘못(7%), 검찰 권한 축소와 독재·독단(5%), 도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피(4%) 등을 꼽았다.)

The ruling party also believes that the government's recent tax reform proposal, which raises tax burdens on ultra-high-value and non-resident single-home owners, along with instability in the domestic stock market, have contributed to the declining approval rating. In particular, as the 4050 generation, once considered the "concrete support base" following the 2030 youth, begins to turn away, a sense of crisis is growing. (여당에서도 최근 발표된 초고가, 비거주 1주택자의 세 부담을 높이는 정부 세제개편안과 국내 증시 불안 등이 지지율 하락에 영향을 미친 것으로 보고 있다. 특히 2030 청년층에 이어 ‘콘크리트 지지층’으로 여겨왔던 4050도 등을 돌리기 시작하면서 위기감이 커지고 있다.)

Indeed, an analysis of opinion poll trends published by Gallup Korea over about four months, from the first week of April to the 14th (second week of August), shows that approval among those in their 40s plummeted 27 percentage points, from 85% to 58%. Approval among those in their 50s also fell 28 percentage points, from 84% to 56%. Since President Lee's inauguration, Gallup polls had shown 4050 approval ratings in the 70-80% range, but this survey marked the first time both the 40s and 50s fell below the 60% threshold. (실제 한국갤럽이 지난 4월 1주 차부터 14일(8월 2주 차)까지 약 4개월간 발표한 여론조사 추이를 분석한 결과, 40대 대통령 지지율은 85%에서 58%로 27%포인트 급락했다. 50대 지지율도 84%에서 56%로 28%포인트 떨어졌다. 이 대통령 취임 이후 갤럽 조사에서 4050 지지율은 70~80%대를 유지해 왔는데, 이번 조사에서 40·50대 모두 처음으로 60% 선이 무너진 것이다.)

During the same period, the average approval decline across all age groups was 23 percentage points (67% to 44%), and among those in their 30s it was 24 percentage points (61% to 37%), both lower than the 40s (27 points) and 50s (28 points). This suggests that the erosion of support among the 4050 generation, the engine of the current administration's governance, is proceeding faster than the decline among younger voters. (같은 기간 전체 연령대 평균 지지율 하락 폭은 23%포인트(67%→44%), 30대는 24%포인트(61%→37%)로, 40대(27%포인트)와 50대(28%포인트)보다 낮았다. 청년층의 지지율 하락세보다 현 정권의 국정 동력 기반인 4050세대의 민심 이반이 더 빠르게 진행되고 있다는 분석이다.)

In the first week of April survey, approval among progressives was 89%, but by the second week of August it had dropped 19 percentage points to 70%. A Democratic Party official said, "Initially, the 2030 generation did not have high approval ratings for the president and ruling party, whereas the 4050 generation was the ruling camp's core support base, with approval ratings near 80% for the president. But as they become disillusioned with recent government policies, the drop in their approval has been even more pronounced." (4월 1주차 조사에서 진보층의 대통령 지지율은 89%였는데, 8월 2주차에선 70%로 19%포인트 떨어졌다. 민주당 관계자는 “당초 2030세대는 대통령과 여당에 대한 지지율이 높지 않았던 반면, 4050세대는 대통령 지지율이 80% 가까이 되는 여권의 핵심 지지층이었다”며 “그런데 이들이 최근 정부 정책 등에 실망하면서 지지율 낙폭이 더 크게 나타나고 있다”고 했다.)

A similar trend appeared in the National Barometer Survey (NBS), jointly conducted and published by pollsters Embrain Public, KSTAT Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research. In the NBS's second week of April survey, President Lee's approval among those in their 40s was 79%, but by the second week of August it had fallen to 63%. Over the same period, among those in their 50s, it dropped from 85% to 67%. (여론조사 업체 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 공동 조사해 발표하는 전국지표조사(NBS)에서도 비슷한 추이를 보였다. NBS의 4월 2주차 여론조사를 보면, 40대 이 대통령 지지율은 79%였지만 8월 2주차엔 63%로 하락했다. 같은 기간 50대는 85%에서 67%로 떨어졌다.)

Yoon Yul, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Myongji University, said in a phone call with this newspaper, "Among the 40s and 50s, the economic backbone, even progressives are angry over the turmoil in the stock and real estate markets. Ideology can't easily overcome the markets and real-world economic conditions." Park Sung-min, CEO of political consulting firm Min, predicted, "As the initial expectations for President Lee fade after taking office, the 4050 generation's assessment of the president is converging with their level of party support. With no clear momentum for the administration to engineer a rebound in approval, the exodus of the 4050, the ruling camp's allies, is likely to continue." (신율 명지대 정치외교학과 교수는 본지 통화에서 “경제적 중심축인 40·50대 중 진보층에서도 주식·부동산 시장 혼란으로 분노하는 상황”이라며 “이념이 시장과 현실 경제를 이기기는 어렵다”라고 했다. 박성민 정치컨설팅 민 대표는 “취임 초기 이 대통령에 대한 기대감이 식으면서, 4050의 대통령에 대한 평가가 정당 지지세 수준으로 수렴하는 것”이라며 “정권으로선 지지율 반등을 꾀할 만한 동력이 마땅치 않아 여권의 우군인 4050의 이탈 현상이 지속될 가능성이 있다”고 전망했다.)

The ruling party is also concerned about defections among the 2030 demographic. According to an online youth perception survey released by the Youth Future Subcommittee of the Democratic Party's National Convention Preparatory Committee, 74% of respondents answered "strongly no" or "no" to the question, "Is the Democratic Party now a party that genuinely listens to the voices of young people?" Anonymous suggestions left by young party members during the survey process included remarks such as "I'm really tired of prosecution reform" and "Policies aren't just about judicial reform." (여권은 2030 지지 이탈도 우려하고 있다. 민주당 전당대회준비위원회 청년미래분과가 공개한 온라인 청년 인식 조사에 따르면 ‘지금 민주당은 청년의 목소리를 진심으로 듣는 정당이다’라는 질문에 응답자의 74%가 ‘매우 아니다’ 또는 ‘아니다’라고 답했다. 조사 과정에서 청년 당원들이 남긴 익명 제안 중에는 “검찰 개혁 정말 지긋지긋하다” “정책이 무슨 사법 개혁만 있는 게 아니다” 등도 있었다.)

President Lee Jae-myung has also issued messages related to youth policies four times this month alone. At a youth policy expert meeting held at the presidential office (Cheongwadae) that day, President Lee said, "In our older generation, saying things like 'failure is the mother of success' or 'youth who take on challenges are beautiful' didn't get us scolded. But now, if you say 'failure is the mother of success' to young people, you'd get slapped in the face," calling for policies that align with the actual needs of young people. (이재명 대통령도 이달 들어서만 청년 정책과 관련된 메시지를 4회 내놨다. 이날 이 대통령은 청와대에서 열린 청년 정책 전문가 간담회에서 “우리 기성세대에서는 ‘실패는 성공의 어머니이다’, ‘도전하는 청년이 아름답다’ 이런 이야기를 해도 혼나지 않았다”면서 “하지만 지금 청년들에게 ‘실패가 성공의 어머니’라고 하면 뺨 맞는다”며 청년층의 실제 수요에 부합하는 정책을 주문했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Says "Core Support Base's Hearts Have Cooled," Pro-Lee Camp Asks "Is He Enjoying This Situation?" (정청래 “핵심 코어층 마음 식어” 친명계 “이 상황이 즐거운가”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Says "Core Support Base's Hearts Have Cooled," Pro-Lee Camp Asks "Is He Enjoying This Situation?" (정청래 “핵심 코어층 마음 식어” 친명계 “이 상황이 즐거운가”)

Candidates for the Democratic Party of Korea's party leadership and Supreme Council positions clashed on the 14th, each offering their own interpretations of President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating, which has hit its lowest point since taking office. (더불어민주당 당대표, 최고위원 후보들은 14일 취임 후 최저치를 찍은 이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율에 대해 저마다 해석을 내놓으며 공방을 벌였다.)

Candidate Jung Cheong-rae said on BBS Radio on the 14th regarding the decline in President Lee's approval rating, "The staunch traditional support base, the core supporters who had answered 'doing very well,' have dropped off and loosened. The hearts of the traditional support base have cooled." He added, "Jung Cheong-rae has the support of the traditional support base. If I become party leader, this will be restored and the approval rating will rise—the moment I take office, the approval rating will likely go up by about 5%." (정청래 당대표 후보는 14일 BBS 라디오에서 이 대통령 지지율 하락에 대해 “‘매우 잘함’이라고 답하던 강고한 전통 지지층, 핵심 코어층이 빠지고 이완됐다. 전통적 지지층의 마음이 식었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정청래가 전통적 지지층의 지지를 받고 있다. 제가 당대표가 되면 이것이 복원되고 지지율이 올라가 아마 제가 되는 순간 국정 지지율이 5% 정도 올라갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Pro-Lee candidates unanimously criticized Jung. Kim Yong, a Supreme Council candidate and a close aide to President Lee Jae-myung, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and targeted Jung, saying, "Is Candidate Jung enjoying this situation? Does he think he'll become party leader at the party convention because the traditional support base's hearts have cooled and the president's approval rating has dropped?" He added, "I am very concerned that it's not the People Power Party but Candidate Jung Cheong-rae who wants the president to become an early lame duck." (친명계 후보들은 일제히 정 후보를 비판했다. 이재명 대통령의 최측근인 김용 최고위원 후보는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 정 후보를 겨냥해 “정 후보는 이 상황이 즐거운가. 전통적 지지층의 마음이 식어서 대통령 지지율이 하락하니 본인이 전당대회에서 당대표가 될 것 같은가”라며 “대통령의 조기 레임덕을 바라는 건 국민의힘이 아니라 정청래 후보가 아닌지 매우 우려스럽다”고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok also drew a line against defining the drop in President Lee's approval rating as an exodus of the core support base. On KBS Gwangju Radio the previous day, Kim said, "If they leave because the mood isn't good, they can't be called core supporters," and "We need to unite the support base, bring in the middle ground, and move toward restoring the original approval rating." (김민석 후보도 이 대통령 지지율 하락을 핵심 지지층의 이탈로 규정하는 데 선을 그었다. 김 후보는 전날 KBS광주 라디오에서 “분위기가 안 좋다고 빠지면 코어 지지층이라고 볼 수 없다”며 “지지층을 단결하고 중간층까지 끌어들이며 원래 지지율을 회복하는 방향으로 가야 한다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil pointed to the results of the June 3 local elections and internal party conflicts as the causes of the approval rating decline. On SBS Radio the previous day, Song said, "In the last local elections and by-elections, we won formally, but the public sentiment is that we lost in substance," adding, "Candidate Jung Cheong-rae and his support base hold the opposite view." (송영길 후보는 6·3 지방선거 결과와 당내 갈등을 지지율 하락의 원인으로 지목했다. 송 후보는 전날 SBS라디오에서 “지난번 지방선거와 보궐선거에서 형식적으로는 우리가 이겼지만 내용상으로는 졌다는 게 국민들의 여론”이라며 “정청래 후보나 그 지지 세력은 반대의 인식을 가지고 있다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party began its public opinion poll on this day, three days before the final results of the August 17 party convention are announced. The party's next leadership will be elected by combining 70% from votes of paid party members and delegates with 30% from a public opinion poll. With only the Honam region (15th) and Seoul-Gyeonggi region (16th) paid member votes remaining, the gap between Candidate Jung and Candidate Kim stands at just 1.45 percentage points, making the public opinion poll results a major variable expected to determine the outcome. (민주당은 8·17 전당대회 최종 결과 발표를 사흘 앞둔 이날부터 국민 여론조사를 시작했다. 민주당 차기 지도부는 권리당원·대의원 투표 70%와 국민 여론조사 30%를 합산해 선출한다. 호남권(15일), 서울·경기권(16일) 권리당원 투표만을 남겨둔 가운데 정 후보와 김 후보의 격차가 1.45%포인트에 불과해 국민 여론조사 결과가 당락을 가를 주요 변수가 될 전망이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Targets Lee Jin-suk... Bill Proposed to Suspend Lawmakers Who Distort or Disparage May 18 for Up to One Year (김민석, 이진숙 겨냥… 5·18 왜곡·폄훼 의원 1년 직무정지법 발의)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Targets Lee Jin-suk... Bill Proposed to Suspend Lawmakers Who Distort or Disparage May 18 for Up to One Year (김민석, 이진숙 겨냥… 5·18 왜곡·폄훼 의원 1년 직무정지법 발의)

Some lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea proposed a revision to the National Assembly Act on the 14th that would suspend the duties of lawmakers who distort or disparage the May 18 Democratization Movement for up to one year. The move appears aimed at Lee Jin-suk, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, who held a public forum the previous day at the National Assembly under the theme of "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement," but if the bill passes the Assembly, concerns have been raised that disciplinary actions against People Power Party lawmakers could be overused. The Democratic Party said it is "not being pursued as a party line," but with Kim Min-seok, a leading candidate for party leadership, listed as a co-sponsor, the bill could potentially be adopted as party policy in the future. (더불어민주당 일부 의원들이 14일 5·18 민주화운동 등을 왜곡·폄훼하는 국회의원의 직무수행을 최대 1년간 정지하는 내용의 국회법 개정안을 발의했다. 전날 국회에서 ‘5·18 민주화운동의 재조명’을 주제로 공개 포럼을 연 이진숙 국민의힘 의원을 겨냥한 것이지만 이 법안이 국회를 통과하면 국민의힘 의원에 대한 징계가 남발될 가능성이 제기된다. 민주당은 “당론 추진은 아니다”라고 했으나, 유력 당권주자로 꼽히는 김민석 후보가 법안 발의자에 이름을 올리면서 향후 이 법안이 당론으로 추진될 수도 있는 상황이다.)

Lee Yong-woo, a lawmaker aligned with the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction, took the lead in proposing the revision to the National Assembly Act that day. The list of sponsors included Kim and 20 lawmakers supporting him. The revision lists grounds for discipline such as spreading false information about democratization movements and state violence whose truth has been nationally confirmed, as well as defamation, insult, slander, distortion, and fabrication. (친명계 이용우 의원은 이날 이 같은 내용의 국회법 개정안을 대표 발의했다. 발의 명단에는 김 후보와 김 후보를 지지하는 20명의 의원도 포함됐다. 개정안에는 징계 사유로 국가적으로 진상이 확인된 민주화운동·국가폭력 등에 관한 허위사실 유포와 명예훼손·모욕·비방, 왜곡·날조 등이 포함됐다.)

It is intended to discipline Lee Jin-suk of the People Power Party. The previous day, Lee held a public forum at the National Assembly Library under the theme of "Re-examining the May 18 Democratization Movement." At the event, remarks such as "To resolve the May 18 issue in the Honam region, we must isolate it externally and divide it internally" were made. In response, the Democratic Party held a rally of condemnation and even submitted a party-line resolution calling for her expulsion. (국민의힘 이진숙 의원을 징계하기 위한 것이다. 전날 이 의원은 국회도서관에서’5·18민주화운동의 재조명’을 주제로 공개 포럼을 열었다. 이 자리에서는 ‘호남 5·18 문제를 해결하려면 대외적으로는 고립시켜야 하고 내부적으로는 분열을 시켜야 한다’ 등의 발언이 나왔다. 이에 민주당은 규탄대회를 열고 당론으로 이 의원의 제명 촉구 결의안까지 제출했다.)

However, under current law, expelling a lawmaker requires the approval of at least two-thirds of all lawmakers (200 members), which is difficult with the Democratic Party's current seat count. Suspension from attendance is possible but only restricts participation in sessions for a certain period, failing to fully block a lawmaker's exercise of powers such as speaking, voting, or proposing bills. For this reason, some Democratic Party lawmakers proposed the revision to bar attendance, speaking, and voting in plenary sessions and committees for up to one year. Under the revision, they would also be unable to perform duties such as proposing or co-sponsoring bills, participating in parliamentary audits or investigations, and would not receive allowances during the suspension period. (하지만 현행법상 국회의원을 제명하려면 재적의원 3분의 2 이상(200명)의 찬성이 필요하기 때문에 지금의 민주당 의석으로는 어렵다. 출석 정지는 가능하지만 일정 기간 회의 참석을 제한하는 데 그쳐 발언·표결이나 법안 발의 등 의원 권한 행사를 전면적으로 막을 수 없다. 이 때문에 민주당 일부 의원들이 최대 1년간 본회의와 위원회 출석·발언·표결을 할 수 없도록 개정안을 낸 것이다. 개정안에 따르면 법률안 발의·공동발의와 국정감사·국정조사 참여 등 의원 직무도 수행할 수 없고, 정지 기간 수당도 지급받지 못한다.)

The People Power Party's stance is that the party leadership advised against holding the forum, but Lee Jin-suk pushed ahead anyway. Chief Deputy Spokesperson Choi Eun-seok told reporters after a floor strategy meeting that day, "The floor leadership also learned about the forum from the media," adding, "Floor leader Chung requested its cancellation before the forum, but it appears the forum was held anyway." Lee held a press conference that day and pushed back, saying, "Are they saying we shouldn't hold a forum about May 18, which they want to include in the preamble of the Constitution? Or are they saying May 18 is the Democratic Party's exclusive property, so we shouldn't touch it?" (국민의힘은 당 지도부가 포럼 개최를 만류했지만 이진숙 의원이 강행했다는 입장이다. 최은석 원내수석대변인은 이날 원내대책회의 후 기자들과 만나 “원내지도부도 언론을 보고 (포럼 개최 사실을) 알았다”며 “정 원내대표가 토론회 개최 전에 취소를 요청했는데 토론회가 강행된 것 같다”고 했다. 이 의원은 이날 기자회견을 열고 “헌법 전문에 싣겠다는 5·18을 두고 토론회를 열지 말라는 건가, 아니면 5·18은 민주당 전유물이니 건드리지 말라는 것이냐”고 반발했다.)

item.title: Military: "Gwangju Air Base to Be Temporarily Dispersed to Seosan, Yecheon, and Chungju" (軍 “광주 군공항, 서산·예천·충주로 임시 분산 배치”)
item.description:
Military: "Gwangju Air Base to Be Temporarily Dispersed to Seosan, Yecheon, and Chungju" (軍 “광주 군공항, 서산·예천·충주로 임시 분산 배치”)

As the government pushes to temporarily disperse the functions of Gwangju Air Base to other military air bases by 2028 to facilitate the construction of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, the Ministry of National Defense announced on the 14th that it will utilize the air bases in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province; Yecheon, North Gyeongsang Province; and Chungju, North Chungcheong Province as "temporary dispersal" sites. (정부가 호남권 반도체 클러스터 건설을 위해 2028년까지 광주 군공항 기능을 다른 군공항으로 임시 분산하는 방안을 추진하는 가운데, 국방부가 충남 서산과 경북 예천, 충북 충주의 군공항을 ‘임시 분산’ 기지로 활용할 예정이라고 14일 밝혔다.)

A Ministry of National Defense official told reporters that day, "Regarding the temporary dispersal deployment, we plan to proceed using Yecheon, Jungwon (Chungju), and Seosan, taking into account minimizing impacts on operational missions and the reception capacity of each base." It is understood that the plan involves a "chain relocation" approach: the functions of the 1st Fighter Wing in Gwangju will be split and moved to the 16th Fighter Wing in Yecheon and the 20th Fighter Wing in Seosan, while some existing functions of the 16th Fighter Wing in Yecheon will be transferred to the 19th Fighter Wing in Chungju. (국방부 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “임시 분산배치와 관련해 작전 운용 영향을 최소화하고, 각 기지별 수용 능력을 고려해 예천, 중원(충주), 서산을 활용해 추진할 예정”이라고 말했다. 현재 광주의 제1전투비행단의 기능을 예천의 제16전투비행단과 서산의 제20전투비행단으로 나누어 이동시키고, 예천 제16전투비행단의 기존 기능 일부를 충주의 제19전투비행단으로 이동시키는 ‘연쇄 이동’ 방식인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, President Lee Jae-myung, at the "2nd Public-Private Joint Review Meeting on Three Major Mega Projects" on the 10th, ordered that the functions of Gwangju Air Base, which had been selected as the site for the semiconductor cluster, be temporarily dispersed elsewhere to make the air base site available for use by mid-2028. The completion of Muan Air Base, the final relocation destination, is targeted for the end of 2032. This means the dispersal to the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju bases will last only about four years, after which operations would need to move again to Muan. (앞서 이재명 대통령은 지난 10일 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트 2차 민관합동 점검 회의’에서 호남권 반도체 클러스터 건설을 위해 클러스터 부지로 선정된 광주 군공항의 기능을 다른 곳으로 임시 분산배치해 2028년 중순까지 군공항 부지를 이용할 수 있도록 하라고 지시했다. 최종 이전 대상지인 무안 군공항의 준공은 2032년 말을 목표로 하고 있다. 결국 예천·서산·충주 기지로의 분산 배치는 4년여 정도만 지속되고, 그 후엔 다시 무안으로 옮겨야 한다는 얘기다.)

Currently, the 1st Fighter Wing in Gwangju is organized with a flight training squadron responsible for advanced flight training and a combat flight squadron performing operational missions. Although the military has not disclosed detailed dispersal plans, it is known that trainer-type aircraft and training systems will likely be concentrated at one location for efficiency. As additional personnel and aircraft are introduced, the dispersal bases will also require new hangar and maintenance facilities, office spaces, and living quarters. (현재 광주 제1비행단엔 고등비행교육 등을 담당하는 비행교육대대와 실전 임무를 수행하는 전투비행대대가 편제돼 있다. 군이 세부적인 분산 계획은 밝히지 않았지만, 훈련기 계열 항공기와 교육 체계는 효율성 차원에서 한곳에 몰아 배치할 것으로 알려졌다. 추가 인력과 항공기가 들어가는 만큼 분산 대상 기지에도 격납·정비 시설과 사무 공간, 생활 시설 등은 새로 마련해야 한다.)

Concerns have also been raised that increased flight activity at the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju air bases could lead to greater noise damage for nearby residents. Additionally, because Gwangju Air Base is a Combined Operations Base (COB) jointly operated by the ROK and U.S. Air Forces, where U.S. air power would be deployed in contingencies, prior consultation with the U.S. side is essential. A Ministry of National Defense official said, "We need to begin administrative procedures and necessary work as soon as possible, and the actual start of construction could be next year." (예천·서산·충주 군공항의 비행 횟수가 늘어나면서 인근 주민들의 소음 피해가 더 커질 수 있다는 우려도 나온다. 광주 군공항은 유사시 미군의 항공 전력이 전개되는 한미 공군 공동운영기지(COB)이기 때문에 미측과의 사전 협의도 필수적이다. 국방부 관계자는 “가능한 한 빨리 행정 절차와 필요한 작업을 시작해야 하며 실질적인 공사 시작 시점은 내년이 될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: All People Power Party lawmakers who received President Lee's golf invitation were constitutional amendment advocates (李대통령 골프 제안받은 국힘 의원들, 모두 개헌론자였다)
item.description:
All People Power Party lawmakers who received President Lee's golf invitation were constitutional amendment advocates (李대통령 골프 제안받은 국힘 의원들, 모두 개헌론자였다)

Various interpretations are emerging regarding President Lee Jae-myung's recent golf outings with People Power Party lawmakers, during which conversations about constitutional amendment took place. Coincidentally, most of the People Power Party lawmakers who played golf with President Lee or received invitations were members of the party's constitutional amendment special committee. In the opposition camp, speculation arose that the President's golf meetings were intended from the outset with "implementing constitutional reform" in mind. Since a constitutional amendment bill requires "approval by two-thirds or more of all sitting lawmakers" to pass the National Assembly, at least 10 of the 109 People Power Party lawmakers would need to vote in favor. The claim is that President Lee, who has made constitutional amendment his "top national priority," has been directly persuading opposition lawmakers through these golf meetings. <<> Within the People Power Party, lawmakers such as Joo Ho-young, Park Deok-heum, Kim Tae-ho, and Shin Seong-beom have either played golf with President Lee or received invitations to do so. Additionally, it was confirmed on the 14th that lawmaker Choi Hyeong-doo also received a golf meeting invitation. Choi reportedly did not play golf with the President due to a scheduling conflict. All of them are advocates of constitutional amendment. <<> Lawmaker Joo Ho-young, about a month after the martial law crisis two years ago, argued for constitutional amendment, stating that "the imperial presidency created by the 1987 system has proven to be past its expiration date." After the People Power Party transitioned to an emergency steering committee system, Joo took on the role of chair of the constitutional amendment special committee. At the time, there were five incumbent lawmakers on the special committee, and Shin Seong-beom and Choi Hyeong-doo were among them. <<> In June, President Lee played golf with Joo Ho-young, who was then the first deputy speaker of the National Assembly, Park Deok-heum, who assumed the role of second deputy speaker, and National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, a former Democratic Party member. It is known that Joo was the first to receive the presidential invitation during that meeting. An opposition figure said, "I understand that when Joo first received the President's golf invitation, he declined, but after repeated offers, he proposed a format where the President would play together with the Assembly leadership," adding, "Although the format was a golf meeting with the Assembly leadership, the person the President most wanted to meet was Joo." <<> Lawmaker Kim Tae-ho, who stated that he proposed a "power-sharing constitutional amendment" while playing golf with President Lee this time, is also a staunch advocate of constitutional amendment, having made "constitutional amendment to end the '87 system" his first pledge when he ran in the 2021 presidential primary. A People Power Party official said, "It appears the President sought to draw out momentum for constitutional amendment within the opposition party through golf meetings with opposition lawmakers." <<> However, some within the People Power Party suspect that the President's contacts with veteran opposition lawmakers, particularly those active on constitutional amendment, through golf meetings signal "an attempt to embrace even factions of the People Power Party and push for a new political realignment." Indeed, President Lee mentioned in a meeting with former President Moon Jae-in in July that "we must constantly expand our base and strive to create a structural majority." At the time, both ruling and opposition camps speculated whether this was "the start of a Lee Jae-myung-style grand coalition embracing moderates and conservatives." <<> Former People Power Party lawmaker Kim Young-woo also raised the possibility of the President's "new political alliance" initiative in an MBC radio interview that day, saying, "It smells of a grand coalition bringing opposition lawmakers into state affairs," and adding, "It doesn't look entirely positive. It could become a political card to shake up the People Power Party." This suggests the President's true intention may lie elsewhere, such as "resolving judicial risks," rather than constitutional amendment. <<> Both ruling and opposition camps are highly uncomfortable with the presidential office individually contacting lawmakers to propose golf outings. People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won said, "The President could communicate with the opposition, but what matters is not just meeting and gathering but resolving issues. What's the point of playing golf when you don't listen to a single word we say in the National Assembly?" The pro-government Rebuilding Korea Party also stated, "While the reckoning for the insurrection is still underway, the President's golf meetings cause deep disappointment." A key Democratic Party official also said, "With the conflict between the pro-Lee and pro-Cheong Wa Dae factions intensifying, there's even talk of a split after the party convention, so I truly don't understand the President's intentions." <<> Within the ruling camp, there are also observations that once the party convention concludes, the Democratic Party will fully focus its efforts on constitutional amendment. Candidate Kim Min-seok, who is close to the President, also said on a YouTube broadcast that day, "Whether it's the President's proposal for a second term or consecutive terms, I agree with enabling two terms to ensure stability," lending support to pushing forward with constitutional amendment. Kim added, "He told me several times before the presidential election that (if constitutional amendment happens) he could shorten his own term." (이재명 대통령이 최근 국민의힘 의원들과 골프를 치면서 개헌에 관한 대화를 나눈 것을 두고 각종 해석이 나오고 있다. 공교롭게도 이 대통령과 골프 라운딩을 하거나 제안을 받은 국민의힘 의원 대부분이 당 개헌특위 소속이었기 때문이다. 야권에선 이 대통령의 골프 회동이 애초 ‘개헌 실행’을 염두에 둔 것 아니냐는 말이 나왔다. 개헌안이 국회를 통과하려면 ‘재적 의원 3분의 2 이상 찬성’이 필요하기 때문에 국민의힘 의원 109명 중 10명 이상이 찬성해야 한다. 개헌을 ‘국정 과제 1호’로 내세운 이 대통령이 골프 회동을 통해 직접 야당 의원 설득에 나선 것이란 얘기다.)

item.title: "Effectively a tax hike"... Pro-Lee party leadership candidates also criticize real estate policy (“사실상 증세”… 친명 당권주자들도 부동산 정책 비판)
item.description:
"Effectively a tax hike"... Pro-Lee party leadership candidates also criticize real estate policy (“사실상 증세”… 친명 당권주자들도 부동산 정책 비판)

Amid fierce criticism from the ruling party over the government's real estate tax and supply measures, pro-Lee (Jae-myung) party leadership candidates have also begun calling for revisions and supplements. (정부의 부동산 세제·공급 대책을 두고 여당에서 거센 비판이 쏟아지고 있는 가운데 친명계 당권 주자들도 잇따라 수정·보완을 요구하고 나섰다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok demanded a review of the government's tax reform plan on Facebook on the 14th, calling the full abolition of the long-term holding special deduction for non-resident single-homeowners "effectively a tax hike." He said, "Eliminating the holding deduction for non-resident single-homeowners is effectively a tax increase for those who own one home worth 1.2 billion won or more—equivalent to most apartments in Seoul—while not residing in it," adding, "Concerns have been raised that this could trigger side effects such as forcing tenants to vacate." (김민석 후보는 14일 페이스북에서 정부의 비거주 1주택자 장기보유특별공제 전면 폐지에 대해 “사실상 증세”라며 정부 세제개편안에 대한 재검토를 요구했다. 그는 “1주택 비거주자의 보유 공제를 폐지하는 것은 서울의 웬만한 아파트에 해당하는 시가 12억원 이상 1주택 비거주자들에게는 사실상 증세인 면도 있다”며 “임차인 퇴거 강요 등의 부작용을 초래할 수 있다는 우려가 제기된다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil also told this newspaper the same day, "Don't touch real estate taxes," and criticized the government's plan, saying, "We're seeing 50 trillion won in additional tax revenue thanks to the semiconductor boom, so I don't understand why they're clinging to 1 trillion won from real estate taxes." Meanwhile, candidate Jung Cheong-rae did not state a clear position on the government's real estate policy, only saying, "The core of the core in real estate policy is the supply policy," and "Normalizing LH is the most urgent priority." (송영길 후보도 이날 본지에 “부동산 세금은 손대지 말라”며 “반도체 특수로 50조원의 추가 세수가 나는데 왜 (부동산 세수) 1조원에 목숨을 거는지 모르겠다”며 정부안을 비판했다. 다만 정청래 후보는 정부의 부동산 정책에 대한 정확한 입장을 밝히지 않고 “부동산 정책의 핵심 중의 핵심은 공급 정책”이라며 “LH 정상화가 가장 시급하다”고만 했다.)

As Democratic Party leadership candidates voiced opposition to the government's real estate policy in the final stretch before the August 17 party convention, ruling party figures remarked, "It shows how sensitive the real estate issue is even among core party members." The Democratic Party is conducting member voting through the 15th in Seoul and Gyeonggi, where real estate sentiment is unfavorable, and is also running a public opinion poll—which accounts for 30% of the primary results—for two days starting the 14th. A key party official said, "When even Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil, who are close to the president, have no choice but to criticize the government's policy, it tells you how volatile public sentiment on real estate is." (민주당 당대표 후보들이 8·17 전당대회 막판 정부 부동산 정책에 반대 입장을 내자 여권에선 “핵심 당원들에게도 부동산 문제가 그만큼 민감하기 때문”이라는 말이 나왔다. 민주당은 15일까지 부동산 여론이 좋지 않은 서울·경기의 당원 투표를 진행하고, 14일부터 이틀간 경선 결과의 30%를 차지하는 국민 여론조사도 실시한다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “대통령과 가까운 김민석·송영길 후보가 정부 정책을 비판할 수밖에 없는 상황이니 부동산 민심이 얼마나 흉흉하다는 얘기냐”고 했다.)

At the party lawmakers' general meeting the previous day, criticism poured in over the government's real estate policy, including remarks like "If we keep going like this, both the general election and the presidential election will be a total disaster" and "President Lee Jae-myung said repeatedly that 'you can't control housing prices with taxes,' and that trust has been shattered." What the ruling party is particularly sensitive about is the strengthened taxation on non-resident single-homeowners. The concern is that if tax burdens increase even for single-homeowners who live elsewhere due to work, children's education, or caring for parents, it could trigger backlash from the middle class in Seoul and the capital region. (전날 민주당 의원총회에서도 정부의 부동산 정책과 관련해 “이대로 가다간 총선도 대선도 폭망한다” “이재명 대통령이 여러 차례 ‘세금으로 집값 안 잡는다’고 해놓고 신뢰가 깨졌다” 등의 비판이 쏟아졌다. 여당이 특히 민감하게 보는 것은 비거주 1주택자 과세 강화다. 직장·자녀 교육·부모 봉양 등의 사정으로 자기 집을 두고 다른 곳에 사는 1주택자의 세 부담까지 늘 경우 서울·수도권 중산층의 반발로 이어질 수 있다는 것이다.)

As opposition within the ruling party grows, the possibility of the government's plan being revised has increased. A Cheong Wa Dae official also said, "The real estate policy will be supplemented through sufficient discussion in the National Assembly." Within the Democratic Party, there are opinions that unavoidable circumstances—such as childcare, family care, or lease contracts—should be broadly recognized as grounds for not living in one's own home. Since the tax reform plan still has to go through the legislative process, some details could be adjusted in consultations between the new leadership and the government after the party convention. <<>> (여당 반발이 커지면서 정부안도 수정될 가능성이 커졌다. 청와대 관계자도 “부동산 정책은 국회에서 충분한 논의를 거쳐서 보완될 것”이라고 했다. 민주당에서는 육아·가족 돌봄이나 임대차 계약 등 불가피한 사유로 자기 집에 살지 못하는 경우를 폭넓게 인정해야 한다는 의견이 나온다. 세제개편안이 아직 입법 절차를 남겨둔 만큼 전대 뒤 새 지도부와 정부 간 협의에서 일부 내용이 조정될 가능성도 있다.)

item.title: Lee "Open to Shortening Term for Constitutional Amendment on 4-Year Two-Term or Re-election" (李 “4년 중임 또는 연임 개헌 위해 임기 단축도 수용”)
item.description:
Lee "Open to Shortening Term for Constitutional Amendment on 4-Year Two-Term or Re-election" (李 “4년 중임 또는 연임 개헌 위해 임기 단축도 수용”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th on X (formerly Twitter), "My official position during the 2022 presidential election was to change the presidential term to a four-year two-term or four-year re-election system to enable accountable politics through mid-term evaluations, and if shortening the presidential term is necessary for a constitutional amendment, I can accept it. That thinking remains unchanged." This is the first time President Lee has publicly mentioned shortening his own term since taking office. (이재명 대통령은 14일 X(옛 트위터)에 “대통령 임기는 4년 중임 또는 4년 연임제로 변경해 중간 평가를 통한 책임정치가 가능하도록 하며, 개헌을 위해 대통령 임기 단축이 필요하다면 이를 수용할 수 있다는 것이 2022년 대선 당시 저의 공식 입장이었고, 그 생각은 지금도 변함이 없다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 자신의 임기 단축을 공개적으로 언급한 것은 취임 후 처음이다.)

President Lee's remarks on constitutional reform came amid growing controversy after Kim Tae-ho, a lawmaker from the People Power Party who played golf with the president last month, said the previous day that "President Lee mentioned a power-sharing constitutional amendment and said shortening his term is possible." In response, the opposition party pushed back, saying, "The president is using tricks to extend his term through a power-sharing presidential system with a cabinet system in mind." In connection with this, President Lee said the same day, "A dual executive system or cabinet system is neither desirable nor feasible in light of public opinion," adding, "It is a misunderstanding to say that power-sharing presidential system or cabinet system means dispersing some presidential authority to the National Assembly." However, President Lee again did not make the statement demanded by the People Power Party that he "will not seek re-election." <<> President Lee had campaigned on a constitutional amendment including a four-year re-election system as a key pledge and his "first state task," but after taking office, he has maintained that constitutional reform should proceed step by step, starting with items agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties, even if only through a "one-point" amendment. On this day, however, he mentioned for the first time since his inauguration a four-year two-term or re-election system. Under a re-election system, a sitting president can serve up to eight consecutive years only if re-elected immediately after their term ends, whereas under a two-term system, a sitting president can run once more and be elected regardless of consecutive election status. President Lee had advocated for a four-year re-election system during the 2025 presidential election. <<> Meanwhile, a Gallup Korea poll released the same day showed President Lee's approval rating at 44%, the lowest on record. This figure is lower than his 44.42% vote share in the presidential election, and by Gallup's standards, it marks the first "dead cross" since his inauguration, with negative evaluations (46%) surpassing positive ones. (이 대통령의 개헌 발언은 지난달 대통령과 골프 라운딩을 한 김태호 국민의힘 의원이 전날 “이 대통령이 분권형 개헌을 언급하며 임기 단축도 가능하다고 말했다”고 밝혀 논란이 커지자 나온 것이다. 이를 두고 야당은 “대통령이 내각제 등을 염두에 둔 분권형 대통령제를 통해 임기 연장을 하려고 꼼수를 쓰는 것”이라고 반발했다. 이와 관련해 이 대통령은 이날 “이원집정제나 내각제는 바람직하지도 않고 국민 여론에 비춰 가능하지도 않다”라며 “대통령 권한을 국회 등으로 일부 분산하자는 것이 분권형 대통령제나 내각제라는 것은 잘못된 이해”라고 했다. 하지만 이 대통령은 국민의힘이 요구하고 있는 ‘연임하지 않겠다’는 발언은 이날도 하지 않았다.)

item.title: 81st Anniversary of Liberation Day... Ruling and Opposition Parties Unite in Voice, "We Will Not Forget the Sacrifices of Fallen Patriots" (81주년 광복절...與野 “순국선열 희생 잊지 않겠다” 한목소리)
item.description:
81st Anniversary of Liberation Day... Ruling and Opposition Parties Unite in Voice, "We Will Not Forget the Sacrifices of Fallen Patriots" (81주년 광복절...與野 “순국선열 희생 잊지 않겠다” 한목소리)

On the 81st anniversary of Liberation Day, the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party spoke with one voice, vowing not to forget the sacrifices of the patriots who gave their lives for independence. (더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 제81주년 광복절인 15일 독립을 위해 희생한 선열들의 희생을 잊지 않겠다고 한목소리를 냈다.)

In a written briefing under the name of spokesperson Kim Hanna, the Democratic Party stated, "Even during the dark hours of losing our nation, we offer our deep respect and gratitude to the fallen patriots and independence activists who never let go of the hope for independence." Spokesperson Kim added, "The history of fighting for independence became the root of the nation, the devotion to protecting the country built today's Republic of Korea, and the courage of the people who safeguarded democracy has made the Republic of Korea stronger." (민주당은 김한나 대변인 명의 서면 브리핑에서 “나라를 빼앗긴 암흑의 시간에도 독립의 희망을 놓지 않았던 순국선열과 애국지사들께 깊은 존경과 감사의 마음을 올린다”고 했다. 김 대변인은 “독립을 위해 싸운 역사가 나라의 뿌리가 되었고, 나라를 지킨 헌신이 오늘의 대한민국을 만들었으며, 민주주의를 지켜낸 국민의 용기가 대한민국을 더욱 단단하게 만들었다”고 했다.)

She continued, "It is our responsibility to build a nation that takes full responsibility for those who sacrificed for the country, a nation where the dignity and sovereignty of every single citizen are respected," and stated, "We will ensure that the light the patriots restored leads to an even more radiant future for the Republic of Korea." (이어 “국가를 위해 희생한 분들을 끝까지 책임지는 나라, 국민 한 사람 한 사람의 존엄과 주권이 존중받는 나라를 만드는 일이 우리의 몫”이라며 “선열들이 되찾아 주신 빛이 더 찬란한 대한민국의 미래로 이어지게 하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

People Power Party floor leader Chung Choun-sook said in a Facebook post that day, "I bow my head in gratitude to all those who devoted themselves to liberation and independence from colonial rule, and to the founding of the Republic of Korea." Floor leader Chung stated, "The freedom and prosperity we enjoy today are possible because of the sacrifices of our ancestors for independence and nation-building," and added, "We will remember the indomitable spirit of independence that burned brightly even in the harshest of times." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 “식민지로부터 해방과 독립, 그리고 대한민국 건국을 위해 헌신했던 모든 분들께 고개 숙여 감사드린다”고 했다. 정 원내대표는 “오늘날 우리가 누리는 자유와 번영은 독립과 건국을 위한 선조들의 희생이 있었기에 가능한 것”이라면서 “엄혹한 시대 속에서도 꺼지지 않고 타오르던 선조들의 독립정신을 되새기겠다”고 했다.)

Senior spokesperson Park Sung-hoon also said in a commentary, "Liberation Day is more than just the day we regained our nation." Senior spokesperson Park stated, "We must reflect once again that today's freedom and prosperity were not given lightly," and added, "Upon the sacrifices of patriots who gave their lives for independence, the sweat and devotion of the people who rose from the ruins of war built today's Republic of Korea." (박성훈 수석대변인도 논평에서 “광복절은 단순히 나라를 되찾은 날 그 이상”이라고 했다. 박 수석대변인은 “자유와 번영의 오늘이 가볍게 주어진 것이 아님을 다시 한번 되새겨야 한다”며 “독립을 위해 목숨을 바친 선열들의 희생 위에 전쟁의 폐허를 딛고 일어선 국민의 땀과 헌신이 오늘의 대한민국을 만들어냈다”고 말했다.)

item.title: National Assembly Speaker Urges North Korea to Positively Accept Inter-Korean Parliamentary Talks (조의장, 北에 “남북국회회담 전향적 수용 요청” )
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik stated on the 15th, the 81st anniversary of Liberation Day, "I once again request the positive acceptance of the 'inter-Korean parliamentary talks' proposed to the North Korean Supreme People's Assembly on Constitution Day." (조정식 국회의장은 제81주년 광복절인 15일 “제헌절 때 북측 최고인민회의에 제안한 ‘남북 국회 회담’의 전향적 수용을 다시 한번 요청한다”고 밝혔다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Speaker Woo said, "We must realize a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula through inter-Korean reconciliation and cooperation, and open an era of coexistence and prosperity in Northeast Asia," making the remarks. (조 의장은 이날 페이스북 글에서 “남북 화해와 협력으로 한반도 평화체제를 실현해 동북아시아 공존과 번영의 시대를 열어야 한다”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

On July 17, in his Constitution Day commemorative address, Speaker Woo had said, "As the Speaker of the National Assembly of the Republic of Korea, I officially propose to the representatives of the North Korean Supreme People's Assembly the holding of 'inter-Korean parliamentary talks' to break the deadlock in inter-Korean relations." (조 의장은 지난달 17일 제헌절 경축사에서 “대한민국 국회의장으로서 북측 최고인민회의 대표에게 교착된 남북관계의 물꼬를 틀 ‘남북국회회담’ 개최를 공식적으로 제안한다”고 했었다.)

That day, Speaker Woo also said, "The free and prosperous daily life we enjoy in the Republic of Korea blossomed from the sacrifices of countless martyrs," adding, "The state must honor independence fighters and their bereaved families with the highest respect and ensure their noble spirit serves as a model for future generations." (이날 조 의장은 “우리가 누리는 자유롭고 풍요로운 대한민국의 일상은 수많은 선열들의 희생 위에서 꽃피운 것”이라면서 “국가는 독립 유공자와 유족을 최고로 예우하고 그 숭고한 뜻을 후대에 귀감이 되게 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

He further stated, "On the issues of Dokdo sovereignty, the Japanese military 'comfort women,' and forced mobilization, we must respond with dignity based on the principles of national stature and human rights, and firmly address any distortion of history that glorifies Japanese colonial rule or damages the honor of independence activists." (또 “독도 영유권, 일본군 ‘위안부’, 강제 동원 문제는 국격과 인권의 원칙으로 당당히 대처하고 일제 식민 지배를 미화하는 역사 왜곡과 독립운동가의 명예를 훼손하는 일은 단호히 대응해야 한다”고 했다.)

Speaker Woo said, "I hope the light of the Republic of Korea becomes a beacon illuminating world peace and prosperity," and "I hope it becomes a nation of dignity, respected by people worldwide through the power of its boundless cultural excellence." (조 의장은 “대한민국의 빛이 세계의 평화와 번영을 비추는 등대가 되기를 소망한다”면서 “한없이 높은 문화의 힘으로 세계인이 존경하는 품격 있는 나라가 되길 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee to North Korea: "Let's Begin Discussions Between the Parties to End the War" (李대통령, 北에 “전쟁 끝낼 당사자 간 논의 시작하자”)
item.description:
President Lee to North Korea: "Let's Begin Discussions Between the Parties to End the War" (李대통령, 北에 “전쟁 끝낼 당사자 간 논의 시작하자”)

On the 81st anniversary of Liberation Day, the 15th, President Lee Jae-myung said, "We who have illuminated the light of liberation, the light of industrialization, and the light of democratization now need a new liberation that will elevate the Republic of Korea to the next level," adding, "We must move toward an irreplaceable Republic of Korea that no other country can substitute." (이재명 대통령은 제81주년 광복절인 15일 “광복의 빛, 산업화의 빛, 민주화의 빛을 밝혀 온 우리에게 대한민국을 한 단계 도약시킬 새로운 광복이 필요하다”면서 “어떤 나라도 대신할 수 없는 대체 불가 대한민국을 향해 나아가야 한다”고 말했다.)

In his commemorative address at the Liberation Day ceremony held at the Sejong Center for the Performing Arts in Seoul that day, President Lee stated, "The Republic of Korea now stands at a critical crossroads of whether it will be swept away by high waves and shipwrecked, or leap forward as a leader enjoying boundless opportunities." (이 대통령은 이날 서울 세종문화회관에서 열린 광복절 경축식 기념사에서 “지금 대한민국은 높은 파고에 휩쓸려 난파될 것인지 아니면 무한한 기회를 누리는 선도자로 도약할 것인지 절체절명의 분수령 위에 서 있다”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "I will completely rearrange the Republic of Korea's resources and capabilities and redraw the growth map to revive the dreams and hopes that have faded in our hearts," and "Just as our ancestors sold their fields to educate their children and built today's Republic of Korea, I will raise the economy's growth potential through active investment in the future and distribute the fruits fairly to the people." (이 대통령은 “대한민국의 자원과 역량을 완전히 재배치하고 성장 지도를 다시 그려내 우리의 마음속 희미해졌던 꿈과 희망을 살려내겠다”면서 논밭 팔아가며 자식들 공부시켜 지금의 대한민국을 만들어 낸 우리의 선조들처럼 미래에 대한 적극적 투자로 경제의 성장잠재력을 높이고 그 결실을 국민께 고루 돌려드릴 것“이라고 했다.)

President Lee particularly said, "I will lay a thick ladder of opportunity covering the entire life cycle so that young people taking their first steps into society can rise again at any time without being discouraged by failure," and "The government will firmly support today's youth so that they can stand tall as the leaders of tomorrow." (이 대통령은 특히 ”사회에 첫발을 내딛는 청년들이 실패에 좌절하지 않고 언제든 다시 일어설 수 있도록 생애주기 전반을 아우르는 두터운 기회의 사다리를 놓겠다“면서 ”오늘의 청년들이 내일의 주역으로 우뚝 설 수 있도록 정부가 든든하게 뒷받침하겠다”고 했다.)

◇Proposal to North Korea: "Let's Begin Discussions to End the War" (◇북한에 “전쟁 끝내기 위한 논의 시작하자” 제안)

President Lee also proposed discussions with North Korea on ending the war. President Lee said, "Peace on the Korean Peninsula will promote stability and cooperation in Northeast Asia and serve as a milestone toward a world without nuclear weapons," adding, "I will embark on the journey to end the war and transform the unstable armistice system on the Korean Peninsula into a peace regime." President Lee said, "Let's begin discussions among the parties to end the old war," and "Through this, effective measures to halt the advancement of the North's nuclear capabilities could also be discussed." (이 대통령은 북한에 종전을 위한 논의도 제안했다. 이 대통령은 “한반도의 평화는 곧 동북아의 안정과 협력을 촉진하고 핵 없는 세계를 향한 이정표가 될 것”이라면서 “전쟁을 종식하고 한반도의 불안정한 정전 체제를 평화 체제로 바꾸는 여정에 나서겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “오래된 전쟁을 끝내기 위한 당사자들 간의 논의를 시작하자”면서 “이를 통해 북의 핵 능력 고도화를 멈출 실효적 방안도 논의될 수 있을 것”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "Last year, I stated from this very spot that we respect the North's system, do not pursue any form of absorption unification, and will not engage in any hostile acts," and also presented three goals: "inclusive peaceful coexistence," "stable peaceful coexistence," and "responsible peaceful coexistence." (이 대통령은 “지난해 저는 이 자리에서 북의 체제를 존중하고 어떠한 형태의 흡수통일도 추구하지 않으며 일체의 적대행위를 하지 않겠다고 밝혔다”면서 ‘포용적 평화 공존’, ‘안정적 평화 공존’, ‘책임 있는 평화 공존’ 등 세 가지 목표도 제시했다.)

Regarding Korea-Japan relations, he said, "I look forward to opening a new 60 years of peace and prosperity together with the Japanese government as 'closer-than-close neighbors' built on deeper trust." (한일 관계와 관련해선 “한층 두터운 신뢰 위에서 보다 ‘가깝고도 가까운 이웃’으로서 평화와 번영의 새로운 60년을 일본 정부와 함께 열어가길 기대한다”고 했다.)

◇"Hold Pro-Japanese Collaborators Accountable... Special Respect for Independence Patriots" (◇“친일 책임 물어야...독립유공자 각별 예우”)

Meanwhile, President Lee said, "I will investigate and recover assets unfairly accumulated by pro-Japanese anti-national actors to hold them clearly accountable to history," and "I will manage the pro-Japanese assets vested in the state more responsibly so that those resources are fully used for the respect and support of independence patriots and their bereaved families." (한편 이 대통령은 “친일 반민족 행위자가 부당 축적한 재산을 조사·환수해 역사에 대한 확실한 책임을 묻겠다”면서 “국가에 귀속된 친일 재산을 더욱 책임 있게 관리해 그 재원이 독립유공자와 유가족에 대한 예우와 지원에 온전히 쓰일 수 있도록 만들겠다”고 했다.)

He also promised special respect for independence patriots. President Lee said, "I will treat surviving patriotic elders and independence patriots with particular distinction, and expand the discovery and commendation of independence activists who have not yet received recognition." (독립유공자에 대한 각별한 예우도 약속했다. 이 대통령은 “생존 애국지사와 독립유공자들을 더 각별하게 예우하고 미서훈 독립운동가에 대한 발굴과 포상을 확대해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Brunson Apology, Military Academies, UNC… Ahn Gyu-baek Always Speaking Inconsistently (브런슨 사과, 사관학교, 유엔사… 늘 ‘딴 말’ 하는 안규백)
item.description:
Brunson Apology, Military Academies, UNC… Ahn Gyu-baek Always Speaking Inconsistently (브런슨 사과, 사관학교, 유엔사… 늘 ‘딴 말’ 하는 안규백)

Amid reports that the United Nations Command recently launched a “Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade,” Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek said on the 14th that “an agreement was reached (with the U.S.) not to (launch it),” only to change his wording to “we are consulting.” Minister Ahn, who reportedly met directly with U.S. Forces Korea Commander and UN Command Commander General Xavier Brunson at Camp Humphries last week to discuss the matter, has seen his remarks waver, raising concerns that there may be a communication problem between South Korea and the U.S. One security expert said, “Isn’t it a serious problem that the defense minister’s remarks on a major security issue are not clear?” <<> Minister Ahn met with reporters on the morning of the 14th and said, “Regarding the creation of the UN Command guard brigade and related events, we (would) probably not (go ahead) — we had discussions and reached an agreement.” Asked, “So the creation itself will not go ahead?” Minister Ahn replied, “That’s correct.” However, the UN Command reportedly has already launched the “Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade,” which integrates the Military Armistice Commission and the UN Command Security Battalion. The UN Command did not deny the brigade’s elevation that day either, stating that it had “consistently informed Korean partners” of the brigade launch plan as well. <<> That afternoon, Minister Ahn visited the Ministry of National Defense press room and said, “On the UN Command guard brigade issue, we are communicating frequently with the UN Command side and are consulting closely within a scope that has no impact on various readiness postures.” The expression “an agreement was reached” with the U.S. had changed to “we are consulting.” <<> Asked, “So isn’t it correct that you agreed not to create (the brigade)?” Minister Ahn said, “Looking at the big picture, it’s a matter to be agreed upon bilaterally, so I think we should approach it that way.” This was interpreted as meaning that the UN Command should scrap the launch of the Guard Armistice Enforcement Brigade. The UN Command is reportedly unable to formalize the brigade’s launch due to opposition from the South Korean government. If the South Korean government insists on the withdrawal of the launch, it could escalate into conflict between Seoul and Washington. <<> In this regard, Michael Bosak, a former deputy secretary of the Military Armistice Commission who served at the UN Command for about six years, told this newspaper that day, “(The brigade launch) is administrative in nature.” He explained that the UN Command Security Battalion is an important organization that requires close communication with the UN commander, but previously it was under the 210th Field Artillery Brigade of the 2nd Infantry Division, creating issues such as the UN Command Security Battalion commander, a lieutenant colonel, having to report directly to the UN commander, a four-star general. <<> Bosak, the former deputy secretary, further said, “At the root of the (South Korea-U.S.) conflict are long-standing issues between the South Korean government and the UN Command.” He added, “The South Korean government does not want to defer to the authority or position of the UN Command when there are differences of opinion, and it is concerned that the U.S. side may be trying to use the UN Command to neutralize the wartime operational control (OPCON) transition.” <<> This is not the first time South Korea and the U.S. have shown differing positions regarding the conversation between Minister Ahn and Commander Brunson. Last February, during a U.S. air training exercise over the West Sea in which U.S. and Chinese fighter jets confronted each other, Minister Ahn spoke by phone with Commander Brunson. At the time, MBC reported that Minister Ahn expressed concern over the exercise being conducted without information sharing, and that Commander Brunson conveyed an apology. <<> On February 24, the Ministry of National Defense said, “We understand that (the report) is partially true.” That night, USFK issued a statement titled “Phone Call with the Minister of National Defense” and said, “We do not apologize for maintaining readiness.” The U.S. said the exercise had been notified in advance, and that Commander Brunson’s response was that Minister Ahn “expressed regret over not being informed in a timely manner.” <<> On the 12th, after Minister Ahn met with the heads of the alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies regarding the integration of the three military academies, the two sides again gave conflicting accounts. The alumni association heads said Minister Ahn “promised to consider” a plan to maintain the current academy system, but the Ministry of National Defense said, “That is not true.” The following day, the alumni association heads said, “Everyone present clearly heard (Minister Ahn’s promise).” In response, Minister Ahn said on the 14th, “How could I say that I would maintain the current system while pursuing academy integration? That is fundamentally difficult.” (유엔군사령부가 최근 ‘경비정전집행여단’을 출범한 것으로 전해진 가운데, 안규백 국방부 장관이 14일 “(출범하지) 않기로 (미국과) 합의를 봤다”고 했다가 “협의하고 있다”고 표현을 바꿨다. 지난주 캠프 험프리스에서 제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관 겸 유엔군사령관을 직접 만나 이 문제를 논의한 것으로 알려진 안 장관의 말이 오락가락하면서 한미 간 소통에 문제가 있는 것 아니냐는 우려가 커지고 있다. 한 안보 전문가는 “중요한 안보 사안에 대한 국방부 장관의 말이 분명치 않은 것은 큰 문제 아니냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Today's Honam Regional Tour Primary... Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae in Tight Race for Biggest Battleground (與 오늘 호남권 순회경선...김민석·정청래 접전 속 최대 승부처)
item.description:
Today's Honam Regional Tour Primary... Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae in Tight Race for Biggest Battleground (與 오늘 호남권 순회경선...김민석·정청래 접전 속 최대 승부처)

The Honam regional tour primary, the biggest battleground of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, takes place on the 15th. The voting results from Honam, the party's home turf where 33% of all eligible party members are concentrated, are expected to significantly influence the race for the party leadership. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 최대 승부처인 호남권 순회경선이 15일 열린다. 민주당 텃밭이자 전체 권리당원 33%의 표심이 모인 호남의 투표 결과에 따라 차기 당권 레이스도 상당한 영향을 받을 전망이다.)

The Democratic Party will hold joint campaign speeches for the regional primary in Naju, South Jeolla Province, and Iksan, North Jeolla Province, on the afternoon of the 15th. The results of the Honam eligible party member vote are expected to be released around 7 p.m. that day. (민주당은 이날 오후 전남광주 나주와 전북 익산에서 순회경선 합동연설회를 개최한다. 호남권 권리당원 투표 결과는 이날 오후 7시쯤 공개된다.)

Honam is the key battleground where approximately 510,000 eligible party members of the Democratic Party are concentrated. The number of party members there exceeds the combined total of the four regions whose eligible party member voting results have already been released: Chungcheong, Busan·Ulsan·South Gyeongsang, Jeju·Incheon, and Gangwon·Daegu·North Gyeongsang. So far in the eligible party member voting, candidate Kim Min-seok leads with 46.01%, ahead of candidate Jeong Cheong-rae (44.53%) by 1.48 percentage points. Candidate Song Young-gil trails in third with 9.47%. As the vote gap between Kim and Jeong is only 3,086 votes, today's results could have a major impact on the race. (호남은 민주당 권리당원 약 51만명이 집중된 핵심 승부처다. 앞서 권리당원 투표 결과가 공개된 충청, 부산·울산·경남, 제주·인천, 강원·대구·경북 등 4개 지역을 모두 합친 것보다 당원 수가 많다. 현재까지 권리당원 투표에선 김민석 후보가 46.01%로 정청래 후보(44.53%)를 1.48%포인트(p) 앞서고 있다. 이어 송영길 후보가 9.47%로 뒤쫓고 있다. 김·정 후보 간 표차가 3086표에 불과한 만큼 이날 투표 결과가 판세에 큰 영향을 끼칠 수 있다.)

On the 16th, the eligible party member voting results from another fiercely contested region, Seoul and Gyeonggi Province, will be released. According to recent polls, candidate Kim Min-seok shows strength in Honam, while candidate Jeong Cheong-rae is strong in the Seoul metropolitan area. Kim's camp says it aims to secure a large margin of victory in Honam to establish a dominant narrative. Meanwhile, Jeong's camp believes that even if it loses in Honam, it can engineer a comeback in the Seoul metropolitan area if the margin is narrow. (16일에는 또 다른 격전지인 서울·경기 지역 권리당원 투표 결과가 공개된다. 최근 여론조사 결과로는 김민석 후보가 호남에서, 정청래 후보가 수도권에서 강세를 보이고 있다. 김 후보 측은 이날 호남권에서 큰 표차로 승리해 대세론을 형성하겠다는 입장이다. 반면 정 후보 측은 호남에서 지더라도 표차가 근소하면 수도권에서 반전을 일으키겠다고 보고 있다.)

The Democratic Party will determine the final winner on the 17th at the national party convention by combining the public opinion poll results. The final outcome will reflect 70% of the eligible party member vote and 30% of the public opinion poll. <<>> (민주당은 17일 전국당원대회에서 국민 여론조사 결과를 합산해 최종 승자를 결정한다. 최종 결과에는 권리당원 투표 70%, 국민 여론조사 30%가 반영된다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Calls President Lee's Liberation Day Address "A Declaration of Giving Up on Youth, Security, Livelihoods, and the Future" (장동혁, 李대통령 광복절 경축사에 “청년·안보·민생·미래 포기 선언”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, criticized President Lee Jae-myung's address marking the 81st anniversary of Liberation Day on the 15th as a "declaration of giving up on the people." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 15일 이재명 대통령의 제81주년 광복절 경축사에 대해 “국민 포기 선언”이라고 비판했다.)

Jang made this statement in a Facebook post that day. He said, "In words, he brought up a 'ladder of opportunity' for young people, but he failed to present any measures or vision," calling it "a declaration of giving up on youth." (장 대표는 이날 페이스북 글에서 이같이 밝혔다. 장 대표는 “말로는 (청년에 대한) ‘기회의 사다리’를 꺼냈지만, 그 어떤 대책도 비전도 제시하지 못했다”면서 “청년 포기 선언”이라고 했다.)

Jang also called it "a declaration of giving up on security." He said, "While proposing to set aside 'mutual threat intentions' toward North Korea, he said not a single word about North Korea's nuclear development or missile tests. When have we ever threatened North Korea? A 'preemptive and sustained peace initiative' ultimately means only we would disarm ourselves." (장 대표는 “안보 포기 선언”이라고도 했다. 그는 “(북한에) ‘상호 위협 의사’ 내려놓자면서 북한 핵개발, 미사일 시험에는 한마디도 하지 않았다”면서 “우리가 언제 북한을 위협한 적이 있느냐. ‘선제적 지속적 평화 조치’는 결국 우리만 무장 해제하겠다는 소리”라고 했다.)

Jang said, "He wrapped up the difficult issues of people's livelihoods in just two sentences," adding, "He spoke about the lives of people struggling day by day under high prices, a high exchange rate, and high interest rates as if it were someone else's problem. It's a declaration of giving up on livelihoods." He also criticized it as "a declaration of giving up on the future." He said, "He didn't even bring up reform tasks such as labor reform, pension reform, or education reform. He just endlessly talked about an empty 'irreplaceable Republic of Korea.'" (장 대표는 “어려운 민생 이야기는 딱 2문장으로 끝냈다”면서 “고물가, 고환율, 고금리로 하루하루가 버거운 국민의 삶을 남 일처럼 이야기했다. 민생 포기 선언”이라고 했다. 아울러 “미래 포기 선언”이라고도 비판했다. 그는 “노동 개혁, 연금 개혁, 교육 개혁을 비롯한 개혁 과제는 아예 꺼내지도 않았다”면서 “공허한 대체 불가 대한민국 얘기만 주구장창 했다”고 했다.)

Jang also said, "He had not a word about Japan's distortion of history, the Dokdo textbook issue, or the comfort women issue. If a conservative administration's president had done this, they would have been ranting about a 'pro-Japanese regime.'" (장 대표는 “정작 일본의 과거사 왜곡, 독도 교과서, 위안부 문제에 대해서는 한 마디도 없었다”면서 “보수 정권 대통령이 이랬다면 ‘친일 정권’ 운운하며 길길이 뛰었을 것”이라고도 했다.)

Jang said, "What the people want is not a grand slogan like an 'irreplaceable Republic of Korea.' It's a promise to revive livelihoods, boost the economy, and protect security. Don't take away our homes, don't extort our taxes, and take proper care of people's lives first." (장 대표는 “국민이 원하는 건 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’ 같은 거창한 구호가 아니다. 민생을 살리고, 경제를 일으키고, 안보를 지키겠다는 약속”이라면서 “집 뺏어가지 말고, 세금 뜯어가지 말고, 국민의 삶부터 제대로 챙기라는 것”이라고 했다.)

Jang said, "At least he didn't bring up constitutional reform. He probably couldn't, since even testing the waters would only backfire. Is saying 'I'll serve only one term as president' really that difficult?" (장 대표는 “그나마 개헌 이야기는 안 했다. 찔끔찔끔 던져봐도 역풍만 맞으니 못 꺼냈을 것”이라면서 “‘대통령 한 번만 하겠다’는 말이 그리 어렵느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Unification Ministry Seeks Alternative to 'North Korea Is Main Enemy'... "Must Change Hostile Language" (통일부, ‘북한은 주적’ 대체 표현 찾는다...“적대적 언어 바꿔야”)
item.description:
The Unification Ministry announced on the 15th that it will begin a public discourse initiative to change the "language of hostility" between the two Koreas. (통일부는 남북 간 ‘적대의 언어’를 바꾸기 위한 공론화 작업에 착수하겠다고 15일 밝혔다.)

The ministry made this announcement while unveiling follow-up measures for the "Three Major Visions for Peaceful Coexistence" proposed by President Lee Jae-myung in his Liberation Day address. It said it would gather opinions from various sectors and consult with relevant ministries to develop concrete plans to replace the term "main enemy" with alternative expressions. (통일부는 이날 이재명 대통령이 광복절 경축사에서 제시한 ‘3대 평화 공존 청사진’의 후속 조치 추진 방안을 공개하면서 이같이 밝혔다. ‘주적’ 표현을 다른 표현으로 대체하기 위해 각계 의견을 수렴하고, 유관 부처와 협의해 구체적인 방안을 마련하겠다는 것이다.)

Based on expert surveys and public discourse, the Unification Ministry will develop an advancement plan for the "National Community Unification Plan" that reflects the vision of peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula and a future-oriented image of unification. It also outlined plans to pursue cooperation in healthcare, tourism in the Wonsan-Kalma area, a Seoul-Beijing high-speed railway, and cooperation linked to the Greater Tumen Initiative (GTI). (통일부는 전문가 인식 조사와 공론화를 토대로 한반도 평화 공존의 비전과 미래 지향적 통일상을 반영한 ‘민족공동체통일방안’ 발전안을 마련한다. 보건의료 협력과 원산갈마 관광 협력, 서울~베이징 고속철도, 광역두만개발계획(GTI) 연계 협력 추진 방안도 밝혔다.)

In border areas, non-military projects will be expanded to establish so-called "peace safety pins." Plans include expanding the DMZ Peace Trail and the Peace-Eeum Train, designating peace economic special zones with infrastructure support, and resuming the restoration project for the Gyeongwon Line. (접경 지역에서는 비군사적 사업을 확대해 이른바 ‘평화 안전핀’을 구축한다. 비무장지대(DMZ) 평화의 길과 평화이음열차를 확대하고, 평화경제특구 지정과 기반 시설 지원, 경원선 복원 사업 재개 등을 추진할 계획이다.)

The ministry also announced plans to restore communication channels to prevent accidental clashes between the two Koreas and to make efforts to restore the September 19 military agreement. Additionally, through the DMZ Peace Trail, the Peace-Eeum Train, the designation of peace economic special zones, and the resumption of the Gyeongwon Line restoration project, it aims to establish so-called "peace safety pins" in border regions. (남북 간 우발적 충돌을 막기 위한 연락 채널 복구와 9·19 군사 합의 복원 노력 계획도 밝혔다. 또 비무장지대(DMZ) 평화의 길과 평화이음열차, 평화경제특구 지정, 경원선 복원 사업 재개 등을 통해 접경 지역에 이른바 ‘평화 안전핀’도 마련하겠다는 구상이다.)

The Unification Ministry stated, "Based on the president's firm commitment to peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula, reaffirmed through this Liberation Day address, we will closely consult with relevant ministries and undergo sufficient public discourse to implement follow-up measures for the 'Three Major Visions' without a hitch." (통일부는 “이번 광복절 경축사를 통해 거듭 확인된 대통령의 한반도 평화 공존에 대한 확고한 의지를 바탕으로 관계 부처와의 긴밀한 협의와 충분한 공론화를 거쳐 ‘3대 청사진’ 이행을 위한 후속 조치를 차질 없이 추진해 나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

In his Liberation Day address, President Lee presented three major visions regarding inter-Korean relations: inclusive peaceful coexistence, stable peaceful coexistence, and responsible peaceful coexistence. The president also proposed beginning discussions on ending the war, saying to North Korea, "Let us begin discussions among the parties to end the old war." (이 대통령은 이날 광복절 경축사에서 남북 관계와 관련해 포용적 평화 공존, 안정적 평화 공존, 책임 있는 평화 공존 등 3대 청사진을 제시했다. 이 대통령은 북한을 향해서도 “오래된 전쟁을 끝내기 위한 당사자들 간의 논의를 시작하자”면서 종전 협의 시작을 제안했다.)

item.title: Song "From Goheung" Jung "Son-in-law of Gangjin" Kim "Gwangju is My Soul"...All Compete to Appeal for Support in South Jeolla-Gwangju (宋 “고흥 출신” 鄭 “강진 사위” 金 “광주는 제 영혼”...앞다퉈 전남광주 지지 호소)
item.description:
Candidates Song Young-gil, Jung Cheong-rae, and Kim Min-seok (in ballot order) running in the Democratic Party of Korea's next party leader election appealed in a joint campaign speech at the South Jeolla-Gwangju regional primary on the 15th, each vying for overwhelming support from party members. They each emphasized their connections to the Honam region, stressing that if elected party leader, they would surely succeed in the "three major mega projects." (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길·정청래·김민석(기호순) 후보는 15일 전남광주 순회경선 합동연설회에서 앞다퉈 당원들의 압도적 지지를 호소했다. 이들은 각자 호남과의 인연을 강조하면서 당대표가 되면 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’를 반드시 성공시키겠다고 강조했다.)

In the joint speech that day, Jung Cheong-rae, who spoke first, introduced himself as "Jung Cheong-rae, a son-in-law of Honam whose wife's family is in Gangjin County, South Jeolla." Jung said, "Gwangju will now go beyond being the holy ground of democratization to become a forward base for an AI powerhouse and semiconductor cluster," adding, "I will surely make the Honam semiconductor cluster succeed with Jung Cheong-rae's drive, breakthrough power, and speed." (이날 합동 연설회에서 가장 먼저 연설에 나선 정청래 후보는 “전남 강진군이 처갓집인 호남 사위 정청래”라고 자신을 소개했다. 정 후보는 “이제 광주는 민주화의 성지를 넘어 AI 강국, 반도체 클러스터의 전진 기지가 될 것”이라면서 “호남 반도체 클러스터는 정청래의 추진력과 돌파력, 속도전으로 반드시 성공시키겠다”고 했다.)

Jung emphasized achieving what he called a "four-way unification." He said, "We must surely make the Lee Jae-myung government succeed together with the democratic citizens of South Korea who voted for Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in, as well as those who voted for Lee Jae-myung," adding, "I will achieve a four-way unification within the party. By uniting and allying the pan-democratic and progressive forces, we will win the general election and presidential election and surely achieve a return to power." (정 후보는 이른바 ‘4통 통합’을 이루겠다고 강조했다. 정 후보는 “김대중을, 노무현을, 문재인을 찍었던 사람들과 이재명을 찍었던 대한민국 민주시민들과 함께 이재명 정부를 반드시 성공시켜야 한다”면서 “당 안으로 4통 통합을 이루겠다. 범민주 진보 세력이 통합하고 연대해 총선, 대선에서 승리해 반드시 정권 재창출을 하겠다”고 했다.)

He also said, "When it comes to loyalty, Jung Cheong-rae is truly grand," and "I will uphold loyalty to the party and loyalty to President Lee. Party members, please protect Jung Cheong-rae." (또 “정청래가 의리 하나만큼은 으리으리하다”면서 “당과의 의리, 이 대통령과의 의리는 정청래가 지키겠다. 당원들이 정청래를 지켜달라”고 했다.)

Next, candidate Song Young-gil introduced himself as "Song Young-gil, a son of Honam from Goheung, South Jeolla," and then strongly criticized the Jung Cheong-rae leadership system as "cooked books." He said, "In the last local and by-elections, we lost 4 of the party's 14 constituencies," adding, "We lost places we should have won, like Seoul and Daegu, and even the President apologized, saying he sees it as a warning from the people. Claiming that as a victory is cooked books." Song said, "The era of prosecution reform has been institutionally completed," and "We must begin judicial reform and build an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." Finally, candidate Kim Min-seok said, "I served three years in prison for Gwangju (the May 18 Democratization Movement). Regarding the "three major mega projects," Kim also said, "I will speed up the relocation of the Gwangju military airfield," and "If needed, I will rush to the United States. Kim said, "If elections wobble and approval ratings wobble, national projects wobble," adding, "There must be no conflict between the party and the administration.
